description: Create a new blog post. Body can be authored two ways: (1) `content` as markdown (GFM) + inline raw HTML, or (2) `blocks` — a structured array of typed layout blocks rendered as styled components (heroes, columns, callouts, code cards, embeds, CTAs, sanitized custom HTML). Prefer `blocks` for rich, magazine-style layouts; use `content` for simple prose. If both are given, `blocks` renders and `content` is kept as a fallback.

authorType.description: Whether the post is authored by an individual user or the organization

content.description: Optional markdown body (GFM + inline raw HTML). Used when `blocks` is not provided, and kept as a fallback when it is. Rich options: ![alt](url), <video src controls>, <iframe> embeds (16:9), <details><summary>, <mark>, <kbd>.

coverImageUrl.description: URL of the cover image displayed at the top of the post

excerpt.description: Short summary or preview text for the blog post

seoDescription.description: Meta description for search engine result snippets

seoKeywords.description: List of SEO keywords for search engine optimization

seoTitle.description: Custom SEO title override for search engine results

status.description: Initial publication status of the post (default: 'draft')

tags.description: List of tag names or slugs to categorize the post

title.description: Title of the blog post (max 500 characters)

name: neuron_create_blog_post
title: Create Blog Post
